model.name: qwen3.8-27b
model.about: Alibaba Qwen3.8, 27B dense, FP8 as published by Qwen. Thinking mode off, so it answers directly like gpt-oss at low reasoning effort. Apache-2.0. A hybrid (linear-attention) model: vLLM's default of 256 sequences exceeds its state cache on a 48 GB card, hence --max-num-seqs 64.

answers.sql:
SELECT
    c.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
    COUNT(t.ACCT_TXN_F_K) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c
    ON t.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY txn_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CUST_K) AS active_customer_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
WHERE c.IS_ACTV = TRUE
  AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE;

SELECT
    j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction,
    COUNT(*) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j
    ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY aml_alert_count DESC, jurisdiction;

SELECT
    br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
  ON t.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br
  ON t.BR_K = br.BR_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY br.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY atm_txn_cnt DESC, branch_name;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dlq.CUST_K) AS client_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D dlq
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dlq.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND dt.MTH_NBR = 8
  AND dt.IS_MTH_END = TRUE
  AND dlq.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

SELECT
    ctg.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
    COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ctg
  ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = ctg.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ctg.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC, complaint_category;

SELECT
    ccy.CCY_CD1 AS currency,
    AVG(rt.AVRG_RT) AS avg_daily_fx_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D rt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
  ON rt.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY ccy
  ON rt.CCY_K = ccy.CCY_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ccy.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY ccy.CCY_CD1;

SELECT
    m.MKT_ID AS market_id,
    SUM(v.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_market_value
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D v
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON v.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY m.MKT_ID
ORDER BY m.MKT_ID;

SELECT
    a.ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.ACCT_NBR_HSH) AS account_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT a
WHERE a.OPND_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND a.OPND_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY a.ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY a.ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT
    br.CTY_NM AS branch_city,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
    ON t.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br
    ON t.BR_K = br.BR_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND dt.QTR_NBR = 1
GROUP BY br.CTY_NM
ORDER BY br.CTY_NM;

SELECT
    AVG(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30';

SELECT
    AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c
  ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.MTH_NBR = 12;

SELECT
    c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.CUST_K) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

WITH all_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
),
active_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM all_customers c
WHERE c.CUST_K NOT IN (SELECT CUST_K FROM active_2025);

WITH auth_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        fa.PMT_STS_CD1
    FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH fa
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
      ON fa.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
        2
    ) AS pct_declined
FROM auth_2025;

SELECT
    ctg.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
    COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ctg
    ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = ctg.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ctg.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY ctg.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT
    SUM(d.TXN_AMT) AS total_txn_amt
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
  ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE d.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
    j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name,
    COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j
    ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY j.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.LN_ID) AS loan_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND d.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.CUST_K) AS distinct_customer_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE t.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
  AND c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH txn_counts AS (
    SELECT
        br.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
        br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
        COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_cnt
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
        ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br
        ON t.BR_K = br.BR_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY br.RGN_CD1, br.DSPLY_NM
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        region_code,
        branch_name,
        atm_txn_cnt,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY region_code
            ORDER BY atm_txn_cnt DESC, branch_name ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM txn_counts
)
SELECT
    region_code,
    branch_name,
    atm_txn_cnt
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region_code;

WITH trf_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        f.CUST_K,
        SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_amt
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
      ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY f.CUST_K
)
SELECT
    c.BUS_ID,
    t.total_amt
FROM trf_2025 t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c
  ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
ORDER BY t.total_amt DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency_code,
    SUM(t.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c
  ON t.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.ISO_ALPH_CD1
ORDER BY c.ISO_ALPH_CD1;

WITH atm_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT at.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN at
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON at.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
wr_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT wt.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wt
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wt.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.CUST_K) AS distinct_customers
FROM atm_2025 a
JOIN wr_2025 w ON a.CUST_K = w.CUST_K;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
    d.CAL_YR_NBR AS yr,
    COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

UPDATE bank_dwh.D_CUST
SET CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'AFFLUENT'
WHERE CTY_NM = 'Cluj-Napoca'
  AND IS_CURR = TRUE;

SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.IS_WKND = TRUE) AS weekend_cnt,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.IS_WKND = FALSE) AS weekday_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH bal AS (
    SELECT
        f.ACCT_K,
        f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT,
        CASE
            WHEN d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30' THEN 'jun'
            WHEN d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31' THEN 'dec'
        END AS period
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
      ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_DT IN (DATE '2025-06-30', DATE '2025-12-31')
),
pivoted AS (
    SELECT
        ACCT_K,
        MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'jun' THEN CLSNG_BAL_AMT END) AS jun_bal,
        MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'dec' THEN CLSNG_BAL_AMT END) AS dec_bal
    FROM bal
    GROUP BY ACCT_K
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS acct_cnt
FROM pivoted
WHERE jun_bal IS NOT NULL
  AND dec_bal IS NOT NULL
  AND dec_bal < jun_bal * 0.9;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        CUST_K,
        CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
        VRSN_NBR,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CUST_K ORDER BY VRSN_NBR DESC) AS rn
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_cnt
FROM ranked cur
JOIN ranked prev
  ON cur.CUST_K = prev.CUST_K
 AND cur.rn = 1
 AND prev.rn = 2
WHERE cur.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 IS DISTINCT FROM prev.CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

WITH txn_quarters AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        t.CUST_K,
        d.QTR_NBR
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
      ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CUST_K) AS distinct_customer_cnt
FROM txn_quarters
GROUP BY CUST_K
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT QTR_NBR) = 4;

WITH dispute_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
wire_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF d
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM dispute_customers dc
WHERE dc.CUST_K NOT IN (SELECT CUST_K FROM wire_customers);

WITH d AS (
    SELECT LN_ID, DYS_PST_DUE
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS
    WHERE BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = DATE '2024-06-30')
),
 r AS (
    SELECT LN_ID, DYS_PST_DUE
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS
    WHERE BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30')
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.LN_ID) AS loan_cnt
FROM d
JOIN r ON d.LN_ID = r.LN_ID
WHERE d.DYS_PST_DUE = 0
  AND r.DYS_PST_DUE > 30

WITH monthly_max AS (
    SELECT
        d.MTH_NBR,
        MAX(d.CAL_DT) AS max_dt
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT
    m.MTH_NBR,
    SUM(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS total_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN monthly_max m ON d.CAL_DT = m.max_dt
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY m.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY m.MTH_NBR

SELECT
    c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.CUST_K) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
WHERE c.EFF_FRM_DT <= DATE '2023-06-30'
  AND c.EFF_TO_DT >= DATE '2023-06-30'
GROUP BY c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

WITH cust_totals AS (
    SELECT
        c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment_code,
        c.BUS_ID AS customer_business_id,
        SUM(t.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
        ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c
        ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
    GROUP BY
        c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
        c.BUS_ID
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        segment_code,
        customer_business_id,
        total_wire_transfer_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY segment_code
            ORDER BY total_wire_transfer_amount DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM cust_totals
)
SELECT
    segment_code,
    customer_business_id,
    total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY
    segment_code,
    total_wire_transfer_amount DESC;

WITH trf_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        t.CCY_CD1
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
      ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
cnt AS (
    SELECT
        CCY_CD1,
        COUNT(*) AS ccy_cnt
    FROM trf_2025
    GROUP BY CCY_CD1
),
tot AS (
    SELECT SUM(ccy_cnt) AS total_cnt
    FROM cnt
)
SELECT
    c.CCY_CD1,
    ROUND(100.0 * c.ccy_cnt / NULLIF(t.total_cnt, 0), 2) AS pct_of_2025_wire_transfers
FROM cnt c
CROSS JOIN tot t
ORDER BY c.CCY_CD1;

WITH monthly_counts AS (
    SELECT
        d.MTH_NBR,
        COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_cnt
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
        ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT
    MTH_NBR,
    wire_transfer_cnt,
    SUM(wire_transfer_cnt) OVER (ORDER BY MTH_NBR) AS running_total
FROM monthly_counts
ORDER BY MTH_NBR;

SELECT
    ccy.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
    SUM(wt.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_volume
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
  ON wt.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY ccy
  ON wt.CCY_K = ccy.CCY_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ccy.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY ccy.CCY_CD1;

SELECT
    c.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
    COUNT(t.ACCT_TXN_F_K) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL c
    ON t.CHNL_K = c.CHNL_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY txn_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CUST_K) AS active_customer_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
WHERE c.IS_ACTV = TRUE
  AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE;

SELECT
    j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction,
    COUNT(*) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j
    ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY aml_alert_count DESC, jurisdiction;

SELECT
    br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
  ON t.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br
  ON t.BR_K = br.BR_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY br.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY atm_txn_cnt DESC, br.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dlq.CUST_K) AS client_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D dlq
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dlq.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND dt.MTH_NBR = 8
  AND dt.IS_MTH_END = TRUE
  AND dlq.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

SELECT
    ctg.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
    COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ctg
  ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = ctg.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ctg.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC, complaint_category;

SELECT
    c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency_code,
    AVG(r.AVRG_RT) AS avg_daily_fx_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D r
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON r.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c
  ON r.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.ISO_ALPH_CD1
ORDER BY c.ISO_ALPH_CD1;

SELECT
    m.MKT_ID AS market_id,
    SUM(v.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_market_value
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D v
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON v.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY m.MKT_ID
ORDER BY m.MKT_ID;

SELECT
    a.ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code,
    COUNT(*) AS account_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT a
WHERE a.OPND_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND a.OPND_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY a.ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY a.ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT
    br.CTY_NM AS branch_city,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
    ON t.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br
    ON t.BR_K = br.BR_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND dt.QTR_NBR = 1
GROUP BY br.CTY_NM
ORDER BY br.CTY_NM;

SELECT
    AVG(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30';

SELECT
    AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c
  ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.MTH_NBR = 12;

SELECT
    c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.CUST_K) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CUST_K) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
WHERE c.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
      AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  );

WITH auth_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        a.PMT_STS_CD1
    FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
      ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
        2
    ) AS declined_pct
FROM auth_2025;

SELECT
    ctg.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
    COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ctg
  ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = ctg.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ctg.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY ctg.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT
    SUM(d.TXN_AMT) AS total_txn_amt
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
  ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE d.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
    j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name,
    COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j
    ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY j.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.LN_ID) AS loan_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND d.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

SELECT
    p.DSPLY_NM AS loan_product_name,
    SUM(r.OTSTN_PRNCP_AMT) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_RPMT r
JOIN bank_dwh.D_LN_PRD p
    ON r.LN_PRD_K = p.LN_PRD_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON r.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY p.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY p.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT t.CUST_K) AS distinct_sme_cross_border_wire_customers
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c
  ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE t.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
  AND c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH txn_counts AS (
    SELECT
        br.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
        br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
        COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_cnt
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
        ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br
        ON t.BR_K = br.BR_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY br.RGN_CD1, br.DSPLY_NM
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        region_code,
        branch_name,
        atm_txn_cnt,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY region_code
            ORDER BY atm_txn_cnt DESC, branch_name ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM txn_counts
)
SELECT
    region_code,
    branch_name,
    atm_txn_cnt
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region_code;

WITH trf_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        f.CUST_K,
        SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_amt
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
      ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY f.CUST_K
)
SELECT
    c.BUS_ID,
    t.total_amt
FROM trf_2025 t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c
  ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
ORDER BY t.total_amt DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency_code,
    SUM(t.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c
  ON t.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.ISO_ALPH_CD1
ORDER BY c.ISO_ALPH_CD1;

WITH atm_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT at.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN at
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON at.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
wr_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT wt.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wt
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON wt.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.CUST_K) AS distinct_customers
FROM atm_2025 a
JOIN wr_2025 w ON a.CUST_K = w.CUST_K;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
    d.CAL_YR_NBR AS yr,
    COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

UPDATE bank_dwh.D_CUST
SET CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'AFFLUENT'
WHERE CTY_NM = 'Cluj-Napoca'
  AND IS_CURR = TRUE;

SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.IS_WKND = TRUE) AS weekend_cnt,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.IS_WKND = FALSE) AS weekday_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH bal AS (
    SELECT
        f.ACCT_K,
        f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT,
        CASE
            WHEN d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30' THEN 'jun'
            WHEN d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31' THEN 'dec'
        END AS period
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_DT IN (DATE '2025-06-30', DATE '2025-12-31')
),
pivoted AS (
    SELECT
        ACCT_K,
        MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'jun' THEN CLSNG_BAL_AMT END) AS jun_bal,
        MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'dec' THEN CLSNG_BAL_AMT END) AS dec_bal
    FROM bal
    GROUP BY ACCT_K
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS acct_cnt
FROM pivoted
WHERE jun_bal IS NOT NULL
  AND dec_bal IS NOT NULL
  AND dec_bal < jun_bal * 0.9;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        CUST_K,
        CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
        VRSN_NBR,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CUST_K ORDER BY VRSN_NBR DESC) AS rn
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT curr.CUST_K) AS customer_cnt
FROM ranked curr
JOIN ranked prev
  ON curr.CUST_K = prev.CUST_K
 AND curr.rn = 1
 AND prev.rn = 2
WHERE curr.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 IS DISTINCT FROM prev.CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

WITH txn_quarters AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        t.CUST_K,
        d.QTR_NBR
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
      ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CUST_K) AS distinct_customer_cnt
FROM txn_quarters
GROUP BY CUST_K
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT QTR_NBR) = 4;

WITH dt_2025 AS (
    SELECT DT_K
    FROM bank_dwh.D_DT
    WHERE CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
dispute_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
    JOIN dt_2025 dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
),
wire_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT w.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
    JOIN dt_2025 dt ON w.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dc.CUST_K) AS distinct_customer_cnt
FROM dispute_customers dc
WHERE dc.CUST_K NOT IN (
    SELECT CUST_K
    FROM wire_customers
)

WITH d AS (
    SELECT LN_ID, DYS_PST_DUE
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS
    WHERE BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = DATE '2024-06-30')
),
 r AS (
    SELECT LN_ID, DYS_PST_DUE
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS
    WHERE BUS_DT_K = (SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30')
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.LN_ID) AS loan_cnt
FROM d
JOIN r ON d.LN_ID = r.LN_ID
WHERE d.DYS_PST_DUE = 0
  AND r.DYS_PST_DUE > 30;

WITH monthly_max AS (
    SELECT
        d.MTH_NBR,
        MAX(d.CAL_DT) AS max_dt
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT
    m.MTH_NBR,
    SUM(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS total_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN monthly_max m ON d.CAL_DT = m.max_dt
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY m.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY m.MTH_NBR

SELECT
    c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.CUST_K) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
WHERE c.EFF_FRM_DT <= DATE '2023-06-30'
  AND c.EFF_TO_DT >= DATE '2023-06-30'
GROUP BY c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

WITH cust_totals AS (
    SELECT
        c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment_code,
        c.BUS_ID AS customer_business_id,
        SUM(t.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
        ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c
        ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
    GROUP BY
        c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
        c.BUS_ID
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        segment_code,
        customer_business_id,
        total_wire_transfer_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY segment_code
            ORDER BY total_wire_transfer_amount DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM cust_totals
)
SELECT
    segment_code,
    customer_business_id,
    total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY
    segment_code,
    rn;

WITH trf_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        t.CCY_CD1
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
      ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
cnt AS (
    SELECT
        CCY_CD1,
        COUNT(*) AS ccy_cnt
    FROM trf_2025
    GROUP BY CCY_CD1
),
tot AS (
    SELECT SUM(ccy_cnt) AS total_cnt
    FROM cnt
)
SELECT
    c.CCY_CD1,
    ROUND(100.0 * c.ccy_cnt / NULLIF(t.total_cnt, 0), 2) AS pct_of_2025_wire_transfers
FROM cnt c
CROSS JOIN tot t
ORDER BY c.CCY_CD1;

WITH monthly_counts AS (
    SELECT
        ddt.MTH_NBR,
        COUNT(*) AS wr_trf_cnt
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF fwt
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ddt
        ON fwt.BUS_DT_K = ddt.DT_K
    WHERE ddt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY ddt.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT
    mc.MTH_NBR,
    mc.wr_trf_cnt,
    SUM(mc.wr_trf_cnt) OVER (ORDER BY mc.MTH_NBR) AS running_total
FROM monthly_counts mc
ORDER BY mc.MTH_NBR;

SELECT
    ccy.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
    SUM(wt.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_volume
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
  ON wt.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY ccy
  ON wt.CCY_K = ccy.CCY_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ccy.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY ccy.CCY_CD1;

SELECT
    ch.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
    COUNT(t.ACCT_TXN_F_K) AS txn_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL ch
  ON t.CHNL_K = ch.CHNL_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ch.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY txn_count DESC, channel_name;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CUST_K) AS active_customer_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
WHERE c.IS_ACTV = TRUE
  AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE;

SELECT
    j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction,
    COUNT(*) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j
    ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY aml_alert_count DESC, jurisdiction;

SELECT
    br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br
  ON t.BR_K = br.BR_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY br.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY atm_txn_cnt DESC, branch_name;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dlq.CUST_K) AS client_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D dlq
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON dlq.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND dt.MTH_NBR = 8
  AND dt.IS_MTH_END = TRUE
  AND dlq.DFLT_FLG = TRUE;

SELECT
    ctg.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category,
    COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ctg
  ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = ctg.CMPLT_CTG_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ctg.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC, complaint_category;

SELECT
    c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency_code,
    AVG(r.AVRG_RT) AS avg_daily_fx_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D r
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON r.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c
  ON r.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.ISO_ALPH_CD1
ORDER BY c.ISO_ALPH_CD1;

SELECT
    m.MKT_ID AS market_id,
    SUM(v.MKT_VAL1_AMT) AS total_market_value
FROM bank_dwh.F_PTF_VAL_D v
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON v.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY m.MKT_ID
ORDER BY m.MKT_ID;

SELECT
    a.ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.ACCT_NBR_HSH) AS account_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT a
WHERE a.OPND_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND a.OPND_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY a.ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY a.ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT
    br.CTY_NM AS branch_city,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
  ON t.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br
  ON t.BR_K = br.BR_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND dt.QTR_NBR = 1
GROUP BY br.CTY_NM
ORDER BY br.CTY_NM;

SELECT
    AVG(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30';

SELECT
    AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c
  ON f.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND d.MTH_NBR = 12;

SELECT
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CUST_K) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

WITH customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
),
active_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM customers c
WHERE c.CUST_K NOT IN (SELECT CUST_K FROM active_2025);

WITH auth_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        a.PMT_STS_CD1
    FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH a
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
      ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
        2
    ) AS declined_pct
FROM auth_2025;

SELECT
    ctg.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
    COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG ctg
    ON f.CMPLT_CTG_K = ctg.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE f.IS_ESCLT = TRUE
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ctg.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY ctg.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT
    SUM(d.TXN_AMT) AS total_txn_amt
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
  ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE d.DSPT_RSN_CD1 = 'FRAUD'
  AND dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
    j.DSPLY_NM AS jurisdiction_name,
    COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_AML_ALRT a
JOIN bank_dwh.D_JUR j
    ON a.JUR_K = j.JUR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
    ON a.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE a.ALRT_SVRTY_CD1 = 'HIGH'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY j.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY j.DSPLY_NM;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.LN_ID) AS loan_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND d.DYS_PST_DUE > 90;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.CUST_K) AS distinct_customer_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE t.IS_CRSS_BRDR = TRUE
  AND c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'SME'
  AND d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH branch_txn_counts AS (
    SELECT
        br.RGN_CD1 AS region_code,
        br.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
        COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_cnt,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY br.RGN_CD1
            ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, br.DSPLY_NM ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR br
        ON t.BR_K = br.BR_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
        ON t.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY
        br.RGN_CD1,
        br.DSPLY_NM
)
SELECT
    region_code,
    branch_name,
    atm_txn_cnt
FROM branch_txn_counts
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY region_code;

WITH trf_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        f.CUST_K,
        SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_amt
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
      ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY f.CUST_K
)
SELECT
    c.BUS_ID,
    t.total_amt
FROM trf_2025 t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c
  ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
ORDER BY t.total_amt DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    c.ISO_ALPH_CD1 AS currency_code,
    SUM(t.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY c
  ON t.CCY_K = c.CCY_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY c.ISO_ALPH_CD1
ORDER BY c.ISO_ALPH_CD1;

WITH atm_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
wr_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.CUST_K) AS distinct_customers
FROM atm_2025 a
JOIN wr_2025 w ON a.CUST_K = w.CUST_K;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

SELECT
    d.CAL_YR_NBR AS yr,
    COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR IN (2024, 2025)
GROUP BY d.CAL_YR_NBR
ORDER BY d.CAL_YR_NBR;

UPDATE bank_dwh.D_CUST
SET CUST_SGMNT_CD1 = 'AFFLUENT'
WHERE CTY_NM = 'Cluj-Napoca'
  AND IS_CURR = TRUE;

SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.IS_WKND = TRUE) AS weekend_cnt,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.IS_WKND = FALSE) AS weekday_cnt
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
  ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025;

WITH bal AS (
    SELECT
        f.ACCT_K,
        f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT,
        CASE
            WHEN d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30' THEN 'jun'
            WHEN d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31' THEN 'dec'
        END AS period
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
      ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_DT IN (DATE '2025-06-30', DATE '2025-12-31')
),
pivoted AS (
    SELECT
        ACCT_K,
        MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'jun' THEN CLSNG_BAL_AMT END) AS jun_bal,
        MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'dec' THEN CLSNG_BAL_AMT END) AS dec_bal
    FROM bal
    GROUP BY ACCT_K
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS acct_cnt
FROM pivoted
WHERE jun_bal IS NOT NULL
  AND dec_bal IS NOT NULL
  AND dec_bal < jun_bal * 0.9;

WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        CUST_K,
        CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
        VRSN_NBR,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CUST_K ORDER BY VRSN_NBR DESC) AS rn
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_cnt
FROM ranked cur
JOIN ranked prev
  ON cur.CUST_K = prev.CUST_K
 AND cur.rn = 1
 AND prev.rn = 2
WHERE cur.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 IS DISTINCT FROM prev.CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

WITH txn_quarters AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        t.CUST_K,
        d.QTR_NBR
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
      ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CUST_K) AS distinct_customer_cnt
FROM txn_quarters
GROUP BY CUST_K
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT QTR_NBR) = 4;

WITH dispute_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT d
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
wire_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF d
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dc.CUST_K) AS distinct_customer_count
FROM dispute_customers dc
WHERE dc.CUST_K NOT IN (SELECT CUST_K FROM wire_customers);

WITH d AS (
    SELECT LN_ID, DYS_PST_DUE
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS
    WHERE BUS_DT_K = (
        SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = DATE '2024-06-30'
    )
),
q AS (
    SELECT LN_ID, DYS_PST_DUE
    FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DSBRS
    WHERE BUS_DT_K = (
        SELECT DT_K FROM bank_dwh.D_DT WHERE CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30'
    )
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM d
JOIN q ON d.LN_ID = q.LN_ID
WHERE d.DYS_PST_DUE = 0
  AND q.DYS_PST_DUE > 30;

WITH monthly_max AS (
    SELECT
        d.MTH_NBR,
        MAX(d.CAL_DT) AS max_dt
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT
    m.MTH_NBR,
    SUM(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS total_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
JOIN monthly_max m ON d.CAL_DT = m.max_dt
WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY m.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY m.MTH_NBR;

SELECT
    c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.CUST_K) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST c
WHERE c.EFF_FRM_DT <= DATE '2023-06-30'
  AND c.EFF_TO_DT >= DATE '2023-06-30'
GROUP BY c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

WITH cust_totals AS (
    SELECT
        c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS segment_code,
        c.BUS_ID AS customer_business_id,
        SUM(t.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_amount
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
        ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_CUST c
        ON t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND c.IS_CURR = TRUE
    GROUP BY
        c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
        c.BUS_ID
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        segment_code,
        customer_business_id,
        total_wire_transfer_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY segment_code
            ORDER BY total_wire_transfer_amount DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM cust_totals
)
SELECT
    segment_code,
    customer_business_id,
    total_wire_transfer_amount
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY
    segment_code,
    rn;

WITH trf_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        t.CCY_CD1,
        COUNT(*) AS ccy_cnt
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
      ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY t.CCY_CD1
),
total_2025 AS (
    SELECT SUM(ccy_cnt) AS total_cnt
    FROM trf_2025
)
SELECT
    t.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
    ROUND((t.ccy_cnt * 100.0) / NULLIF(x.total_cnt, 0), 2) AS pct_of_2025_wire_transfers
FROM trf_2025 t
CROSS JOIN total_2025 x
ORDER BY t.CCY_CD1;

WITH monthly_counts AS (
    SELECT
        d.MTH_NBR,
        COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_cnt
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF w
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d
        ON w.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY d.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT
    m.MTH_NBR,
    m.wire_transfer_cnt,
    SUM(m.wire_transfer_cnt) OVER (
        ORDER BY m.MTH_NBR
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS running_total
FROM monthly_counts m
ORDER BY m.MTH_NBR;

SELECT
    ccy.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
    SUM(wt.ORGNL_AMT) AS total_wire_transfer_volume
FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF wt
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt
  ON wt.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CCY ccy
  ON wt.CCY_K = ccy.CCY_K
WHERE dt.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
GROUP BY ccy.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY total_wire_transfer_volume DESC;
